market_question: Will Dan Sullivan win the Alaska Senate race in 2026?
reasoning: Dan Sullivan is an incumbent Republican Senator in a state that leans safely Republican (Trump +10 in 2020, PVI R+8). Incumbents usually hold their seats; Sullivan won reelection in 2020 by 12 points. While Alaska’s new ranked-choice voting system introduces some uncertainty, no strong challenger has emerged, and national midterm dynamics would likely favor Republicans if a Democrat is president. The market’s 39.5% probability significantly undervalues his chances.
evidence_points: Sullivan won his 2020 re-election by 12 points.
Alaska has a Republican lean (Cook PVI R+8, Trump +10).
Incumbent Senators win over 80% of the time in safe states.
